meetings.summary: The Parks Commission approved funding for a replacement Fitzgerald Field sign and approved a private-donation project to demolish and rebuild two dugouts at Powell Field. budget_items.topic: Town beach revenue vs. salary costs
budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director said town beach pass and lesson revenue covers around half of the town beach's salary expenses, with the town covering the rest.
The chair listed the current resident family, individual, senior, and daily pass rates, last raised in 2024.
The chair proposed roughly doubling all beach pass and swim lesson rates to move toward a self-sustaining program, citing the family pass as an example.
The chair cited Holden's pool family and individual pass prices as a comparison point for the proposed increase.
A member cited a local country club's non-resident and resident family and individual pool membership prices as further comparison.

budget_items.topic: Non-resident youth club field use fee
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair described the current per-child non-resident youth organization field fee as possibly too low for an outside club-level team using fields extensively, compared to what Lunenburg's own program pays for a season.
The chair described DCR's hourly and seasonal block rental rates for fields as a possible alternative pricing model to consider.
